finding: A fixed 75% minimum-fill completion threshold plus a $12 absolute unmatched-risk budget can label an economically unhedged structural basket COMPLETE. In the current three-leg Graph/RV price geometry, a 100%/75%/75% fill pattern passes both gates while two terminal states lose about $10.41, despite the fully matched basket having only about $1.22 of guaranteed structural profit.
required_successor_contract: Separate operational fill progress from economic hedge completion.
After residual cancels become effective, recompute common matched units and residual exposure from actual fills.
For structural baskets, require the guaranteed terminal payoff after entry costs, verified fees, slippage and residual unwind to remain positive before holding a bundle as economically complete.
If residual exposure erases the structural edge, rebalance or unwind rather than treating the basket as complete.
Report operational completion and economic completion separately in fill-conditioned PnL evidence.
